verdict.rationale: Snowflake's own documented features act on many items at once. COPY INTO loads many files and skips ones already loaded, and Snowpipe loads files in micro-batches. Time Travel can restore all objects inside a container, and cloning a database or schema carries over all child objects with their privileges. Programmatic paths (SQL API, Snowpark, Cortex AI Functions) run set-based operations at scale. Missing for 10: an explicit dedicated bulk-operations doc page, any evidence of bulk actions driven through the CLI, REST API or MCP agent surfaces, and independent hands-on corroboration beyond one community note on COPY.
